items.name: Subdominant approach to climax
items.description: The emotional peak is often approached through the subdominant (IV) rather than the dominant (V). Specifically: bVI → IV → I (the flat-sixth to subdominant to tonic), creating a "dark triumph" quality

items.name: Bell-like resonance — tonic pedal under chromatic harmony
items.description: The tonic is sustained in the bass as a pedal point while harmonies above it move through chromaticism, creating a sense of resonance (like a church bell that keeps ringing while the overtones change)
